comparison.objective: PR-1720 removes a binder clip before feeding invoices into a shredder; the candidate adjusts gripper hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1720 tests clip opening/removal, paper-stack alignment, guarded insertion, and hand clearance, not torque or angular calibration.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1720 requires the clip safely separated and the paper shredded without a jam or fingertip entry; the candidate requires stop-angle retention through repeated motion.
comparison.reason: Safe preprocessing and feeding of a paper stack is unrelated to coupled screw-and-nut adjustment.
